name: FlexSeries Shaving Kit
editorialDescription: A rotary head shaver kit built around snap-on attachments: a five-blade rotary head, a precision clipper with 3, 5 and 7mm guards, a nose-and-ear trimmer, an exfoliating brush and a scalp scrubber. It's designed mainly for shaving your head, with face and body grooming as extras. Freebird was previously called Freedom Grooming. Its own pages disagree on a few specs, such as the water-resistance rating and runtime, so we show those as ranges.
keyFeatures: Five-blade rotary shaving head plus four snap-on attachments
USB charging; the Amazon listing says about 90 minutes to charge for up to 90 minutes of use, while Freebird's site says a 60-minute charge
Wet or dry use; Freebird lists the rating as IPX5 or IPX6 depending on the page, and the listing advises keeping it out of direct water flow
Freebird suggests replacing the rotary blade about every 50 shaves (the listing says every 4 weeks)
Includes a USB cable and a cleaning brush; model FS1-1-US
advantages: Many attachments in one kit; the instructions have you clip long hair first and then shave
A rotary head designed to follow the curves of the scalp
A 3-year standard warranty, extended to lifetime with an active blade subscription, per Freebird's FAQ
Freebird says opened and used shavers can be returned within its trial period
disadvantages: Replacement blades are an ongoing cost
Specifications (water rating, runtime, trial length) are inconsistent across Freebird's own pages
Not designed to be submerged or used under running water
Long, dense hair needs trimming first or the rotary head struggles
'No bumps or irritation' wording is a brand claim; results vary with skin and technique
suits: People who shave their head regularly
Anyone who wants one kit for head, face and body grooming
skipIf: You only trim and never shave to the skin
You don't want to buy replacement blades
You want a fully waterproof shaver for use in the shower
buyingConsiderations: This is the original five-blade FlexSeries; the FlexSeries Pro is a separate four-blade model rated IPX7
Read the warranty terms; lifetime coverage depends on a blade subscription
Check that the seller is Freebird Headcare
